title: Emily Slater discusses legal finance in bankruptcy and restructuring on Octus podcast
summary: Legal finance can provide creditors and other stakeholders with capital to pursue valuable claims while managing the costs and risks of litigation. In an episode of Octus' “Industry Insights: Exclusive Interviews” podcast, Burford Managing Director Emily Slater discusses the role of legal finance in bankruptcy and restructuring, including underwriting considerations, litigation risks and the types of claims that arise in bankruptcy proceedings. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Legal finance can provide creditors and other stakeholders with capital to pursue valuable claims while managing the costs and risks of litigation. In an episode of Octus' “Industry Insights: Exclusive Interviews” podcast, Burford Managing Director[Emily Slater](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/emily-slater/) discusses the role of legal finance in bankruptcy and restructuring, including underwriting considerations, litigation risks and the types of claims that arise in bankruptcy proceedings.
